faq.q: What's included in the 450,000 Gs setup?
faq.a: Site design and development, CRM configuration, WhatsApp Business integration, and the initial audit of your campaigns. One payment.

faq.q: Can I pay monthly instead of annual?
faq.a: Yes. Monthly is 639,000 Gs. Annual pays 10 months (2 months free).

faq.q: How long until my site is in production?
faq.a: 2–4 weeks to launch, depending on number of pages and whether you already have materials (photos, texts, logo).
Before launch we show you the system running and you test it. If something doesn't fit, we adjust before going to production. After launch there's a 30-day guarantee.

faq.q: Which industries do you work with?
faq.a: Professional services, mid-market retail, multi-location hospitality, private health. If you bill over 50M Gs/month and have a sales team, we're a fit.
